summary: Clackamas County, OR site: 1923 open shelter with cupola, 1932 ground cabin, deactivated 1964, destroyed 1969 or removed by 1970; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 1923 open-sided shelter with windowless cupola; 1932 ground cabin (L-5 per register, L-4 per Forest Fire Lookout Association)
facts.status_note: Removed; register says removed by 1970, Forest Fire Lookout Association says destroyed in 1969. No source describes what remains today.

events.note: First lookout: open-sided shelter with windowless cupola on the roof
Ground cabin; register says L-5, Forest Fire Lookout Association says L-4
Linoleum laid on the floor; aerial markings painted
Forest Fire Lookout Association: destroyed in 1969

evidence.supports: site is in Clackamas County, Oregon
U.S. Forest Service administers the site
site lies about 20 miles southwest of Mount Hood
first lookout an open-sided shelter with windowless cupola, built 1923
evidence.quote: The first lookout was an open-sided shelter with a windowless cupola on the roof built in 1923.
In 1932, an L-5 ground cabin was built, which was removed by 1970.

evidence.supports: first developed about 1923 with an open-sided shelter and cupola
evidence.quote: First developed about 1923 with an open-sided shelter and windowless cupola on the roof, this L-4 ground cabin, built in 1932, was destroyed in 1969.
Painting job accomplished this year at Indian Ridge Lookout.
Linoleum was placed on the floor at Bedford Point Lookout and Indian Ridge Lookout.
Aerial markings were painted on Bedford Point Lookout, Squaw Mt. And Indian Ridge Lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed by 1970; Forest Fire Lookout Association says destroyed in 1969; Forest Lookouts gives no year. The story reports both and does not choose one.
Register calls the 1932 ground cabin an L-5; Forest Fire Lookout Association calls it an L-4. Both are reported.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains at the site today, and no access information was found, so no access fact is recorded. A web search returned a different Indian Ridge Lookout (Recreation.gov listing 234173, Willamette National Forest near Blue River, dated 1958 to 1973); it is not this site and was not used, so the story does not mention it. No staffing names or fires were found in the sources read. The brief's FFLOS registration date (August 26, 2010) is not in the fetched register text, so no fflos_registered event was added. Elevation (4,308 ft) matches the register but no elevation key exists in the facts schema. Photos not added: the page text carries no image URLs.
